max_depth.description: Max spawn depth below the branch root (root = 0). Spawns deeper than this are refused. Default 3.

max_runs.description: Per-branch cap on total work items (branch = root work id plus all descendants). Default 10.

delta.description: Epistemic delta of one run. All counters are integers >= 0. The convergence detector and the frontier score read ONLY these observables.

next_frontier.description: The agent's structured pointer at the next unresolved piece of knowledge. Advisory — the orchestrator still scores and selects; this never self-schedules.

priority_basis.description: Observable bases ONLY. Deliberately excludes self-reported uncertainty — the worker never supplies a score or a confidence multiplier. 'manual' marks human-seeded items; the orchestrator still scores them from observables.

origin.description: Where the item came from. 'spawn' items must name their parent.

parent_work_id.description: The work item whose run spawned this one. Null for roots.

run_id.description: The run that created this item, when created by a run (spawn path). Null otherwise.

run_result.description: The mandatory machine-readable terminus of every agent run. Missing any required structured field is a validation error, not a soft warning: prose-only reflection does not count as completion.

changed_claims.description: Ids of claims changed by this run. May be empty, must be present.

contradictions_found.description: Ids of contradiction nodes surfaced. May be empty, must be present.

notes.description: Optional free prose. Never a substitute for the structured fields — a result with notes but missing any required field FAILS validation.

spawned_work.description: Structured follow-up investigations. Empty array is legal and common — a run that found nothing new spawns nothing. Prose like 'X may deserve further investigation' without an entry here is not a spawn.

budget.description: Optional override. Absent: inherits the parent branch budget.

provenance.description: Parent is required on every spawn. Origin is forced to 'spawn' and run_id is filled by the ingestor.

reason.description: What the parent run discovered that makes this investigation necessary.

work_id.description: Stable work identifier, zero-padded, monotonically assigned (work-0001, work-0002, ...). Never reused.

blocked_reason.description: Required when status is blocked: why (e.g. branch budget exhausted, depth exceeded).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Used for staleness scoring.

created_by.description: Who/what created the item: a handle, 'orchestrator', or 'agent-run:<run_id>'.

dependencies.description: Work ids that should complete first. Default []. Feeds dependency_impact scoring.

reason.description: Why this investigation is warranted. Required — 'Paci may deserve further investigation' without a structured reason never becomes an item; the reason is the structured record.

score.description: Last orchestrator-computed frontier score. Informational only — never supplied by the worker, never trusted on input.

target.description: What the investigation targets: an article path, entity id, claim id, timeline id, or 'global' for corpus_discovery.

work_status.description: Lifecycle: queued -> active -> completed | blocked | converged. No other transitions exist.

work_type.description: The eight investigation kinds. A work item is an investigation, not an editing operation.

description: Execution-layer schema for the autonomous research loop. This schema governs WORK ONLY: queue items, spawned work, agent run results, and the next-frontier pointer. It does not touch the epistemic layer (schema/node.schema.json) — nodes, edges, layers L0-L5, and bin/wb-validate semantics are unchanged. Validation of this schema's subset is enforced by bin/wb-work's built-in checker (stdlib only); the constructs used here are exactly those the checker supports: type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, pattern, minimum, minLength, items, anyOf, $defs/$ref.
title: Recursive Work Engine v1 — work items, spawns, run results
